name: AINAN full asset reboot — authoring acceptance contract

inventoryClassPolicy.legacy-compatible-manifest: Existing ready production/reference assets. Still load in current app; retire only after accepted replacement and rollback.
inventoryClassPolicy.qa-only: Experiment/geometry-only preview. Never silently promoted to production, even when CI succeeds.
inventoryClassPolicy.composition-reference: Existing mock/source preserved as art/interaction benchmark, not render-ready replacement.
inventoryClassPolicy.candidate: New independently authored source and transparent parts pending pixel/QA review.
inventoryClassPolicy.accepted: Visual and browser acceptance linked to specific asset hashes and a reviewer decision.
inventoryClassPolicy.production: Explicitly switched in the current game with tested fallback/rollback, distinct from accepted.

promotionGates: valid independent source file / no embedded player+UI into world
alpha and pixel checksum, pivot/socket metadata
390x844 and true landscape real Browser screenshot with no clipping
CI PR and main deployed state; physical iPhone is separately checked
forbidden: patch old hidden actor hole by horizontal copy, Telea-only fill, or stretched water
publish an explanatory mock board as gameplay background
overlay character/rod/cat/HUD permanently into world layer
auto-approve visual quality from gradients, seam counters, golden comparisons, or green CI
delete old art or silently mutate IDs / saved data before replacement accepted

art.light: Bright coastal sun, coherent directional shading throughout sea, quay and player
art.sea: Saturated teal toward rich deep cyan, irregular sparkle/wave clusters, visible depth with clear lure and fish contrast
art.harbor: Actual dock top + front face in perspective; warm sunlit board/stone with believable joins, never copied mooring structures
art.character: Readable illustrated warm outfit/face and rod at phone scale, consistent head/body/perspective among variants; no baked scenery
art.fish: Species-specific silhouettes and fins with restrained highlights; heroes distinct without generic recolors
art.ui: Compact pale-blue HUD, dark navy/gold controls, high contrast; UI separate from scrollable world
reject: identical textures pasted into distant ocean

world.castAxis: visual from lower-left toward upper-right; input mechanics unchanged until W04
world.camera: follow rod tip then lure beyond viewport, ease on splash, favor lure and fish on retrieve
world.safeZone: no obstacles in rod swing, flight arc or taut line retrieve including visual cat / options

layers.role: non-repeating continuous open ocean, reflection, swells
footing only: dock top/front away from cast lane
single native rod owner and separate reel/line
independent cat/option behind player and outside clear lane
screen space only and inside safe area

world.sourceCanvas: Decide via actual maximal lure-camera path + viewport size; old 2160x1800 atlas is a QA provisional geometry only.
world.parallax: World layer values must be validated together; do not independently pan quay/sea during lure follow.

player.ownerRule: single graphic owner for rod and line, accessory sprites follow actor pose sockets
player.provisionalQA: PR #215 assets only test position and silhouette, not finished gender/outfit/approved cat art

acceptance.workUnit217: source inventory SHA + historical/QA categorization, contract and crop/responsive correction checked in CI
acceptance.workUnit218: high-quality independent full-world Harbor layers approved by artist on staged browser frames
acceptance.workUnit219: separate player body/outfit/rod/companion alpha with compatible pose sockets in real game
acceptance.workUnit220: real Cast>Retrieve>Hit>Battle>Result with visual + save regression, vertical and landscape
acceptance.workUnit221: Bay/Cape/fish/town/UI consistency, release rollback and screen evidence
